newsitem.title: PERU: Lima shrs slip to soft close, weak Q3 reports seen.
newsitem.headline: Lima shrs slip to soft close, weak Q3 reports seen.

text.p: Shares on the Lima stock exchange closed slightly down Tuesday in meager volume as investors expected poor third quarter company results, brokers said.

"There are few investors -- foreign or local -- in the market," said Vanesa Chiesa of local brokerage Cruz Blanca. "The expectation in the air is that some companies are not going to have positive results."
Tuesday, the General Index fell 1.03 percent to 1,538.69 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index slipped 0.10 percent to 2,125.56 points, according to preliminary stock figures.
Cement company Cementos Lima dropped 0.28 percent to 3.56 soles, in 14 percent of the day's total volume.
Backus y Johnston -- the country's largest brewery -- resisted the market's general undertow and rose 0.39 percent to 2.58 with eight percent of total volume.
